name: closure counter
code:
def make_counter():
    n = 0
    def inc():
        nonlocal n
        n += 1
        return n
    return inc
a = make_counter()
b = make_counter()
print(a(), a(), a(), b(), a())

name: make adder higher order
code:
def make_adder(n):
    def add(x):
        return x + n
    return add
add5 = make_adder(5)
add10 = make_adder(10)
print(add5(3), add10(3), make_adder(100)(1))
fns = [make_adder(i) for i in range(3)]
print([f(10) for f in fns])

name: generator pipeline
recursive flatten
manual fold reduce
code:
def fold(fn, xs, init):
    acc = init
    for x in xs:
        acc = fn(acc, x)
    return acc
print(fold(lambda a, b: a + b, [1, 2, 3, 4], 0))
print(fold(lambda a, b: a * b, [1, 2, 3, 4], 1))
print(fold(lambda a, b: a if a > b else b, [3, 9, 2], 0))
print(fold(lambda a, b: a + [b], [1, 2, 3], []))
